#/properties/pos/properties/quickSearch/: Extra Kibana Query Language (KQL) clause that is always AND-ed with every quick search. Use it to pre-narrow the catalog (assortment, brand, tags, additional properties, and similar) so typical searches run against a smaller set of items. This is not a default search term and is not shown or editable in the POS. Cashiers still type a query as usual. Leave unset, null, or empty for no extra filtering. Platform constraints still apply (sellable STOCK/SERVICE items, current sales prices, active identifiers, and item status). Invalid KQL makes quick search fail for all users — test the expression in the Complete Item query playground before rollout. KQL syntax: https://www.elastic.co/docs/explore-analyze/query-filter/languages/kql Complete Item fields and nested additional-property syntax: https://developer.hiiretail.com/docs/product-price-and-promotion/concepts/capabilities/querying-for-data/#how-it-works
Controls whether and how an item identifier is shown in quick search results: none, the standard identifier, or a custom additional-property ID.
Show an item identifier in quick search results. Uses the primary identifier (isPrimary), falling back to any other active identifier.
Show the value of this additional item property instead of the standard identifier. If an item has no such property, no identifier is shown.
